deletion.title: Delete account
deletion.description: Close your account and permanently remove the data stored in Postmade.
deletion.warning: Your workspaces, drafts, scheduled posts, and social network connections will be removed from Postmade. Posts that have already been published will remain available on their respective social networks.
deletion.externalWorkspacesDescription_one: Your membership in {{count}} workspace will be removed.
deletion.externalWorkspacesDescription_other: Your memberships in {{count}} workspaces will be removed.
deletion.activeSubscriptionBlockedDescription: Your subscription is still active. Cancel it to continue deleting your account.
deletion.pastDueBlockedDescription: We found an outstanding payment on your subscription. Resolve the payment to continue deleting your account.
deletion.cancellationScheduledDescription: Your subscription will not renew, and access remains available until {{date}}. You can delete your account now, but access will end immediately and the remaining period will not be refunded.
deletion.cancellationScheduledWithoutDate: Your subscription will not renew. You can delete your account now, but access will end immediately and any remaining period will not be refunded.
deletion.reasonQuestion: What is the main reason for deleting your account?

reasons.price: The price doesn't meet my needs
reasons.difficult_to_use: I found the product difficult to use

deletion.optionalComment: Would you like to add anything? (optional)
deletion.irreversibleWarning: This operation is permanent. Your account and the data stored in Postmade cannot be recovered. Posts already sent to social networks will not be deleted from those platforms.
deletion.googleReauthenticationDescription: Confirm your identity with Google again.
deletion.success: Your account has been permanently deleted.
deletion.error: We couldn't delete the account. Check your authentication and try again.
